name: Echo Slide
description: The first clip slides away leaving a trail of discrete fading copies of itself, a stroboscopic echo, and the echoes of the second clip converge into place. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the clips slide (x right, y up)

params.name: echoes
params.description: Number of echoes between the two clips

params.name: trail
params.description: How long the echoes trail behind each clip, as a part of the transition

params.name: decay
params.description: How fast the echoes of the first clip fade out into those of the second
